fields.title: Miami Life, Volume 4, Number 15 (1927-04-23)
creator: Wen R. Phillips
subject: Miami (Fla.) politics and government
City commission elections
Public utilities regulation
Florida Power & Light Company
Transportation contracts and jitneys
Everglades drainage
Taxation
Civic boosterism and tourism
University of Miami stadium fundraising
Coast Guard investigations
Prohibition and alcohol smuggling
fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami municipal politics and the May 3 city commission election, criticizing public-utility influence (Florida Power & Light) and city contracts (including jitney/bus arrangements), and discussing taxation and municipal spending. Articles address Everglades drainage proposals, civic image/boosterism, and a call to support the University of Miami stadium campaign. Additional pieces mention Coast Guard investigations and Prohibition-era alcohol shipments, along with local society-style columns, advertisements, and a paid political open letter by Abe Aronovitz.
